system.description: Exotic hemovores infest your flesh, and you cannot command or expel them. When you go into play at the beginning of the evening, make the usual vitae test; once you learn your level of vitae, make four Simple Tests, and each loss or tie indicates a Blood Trait lost to your parasites. You also suffer a one-Trait penalty on Self-Control tests. Roleplay the constant itching the parasites give you, and wear a tag indicating that your skin is quite literally crawling.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
